text_sections.text: [DNA Digivolve] Purple Lv.5 + red Lv.5: Cost 0

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast DNA Digivolve ([Dinobeemon] + [Paildramon])＞ (1 of your specified Digimon and 1 specified card in the hand may DNA digivolve into this card.) [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 11000 DP or less. Then, if DNA digivolving, this Digimon may digivolve into [Imperialdramon: Fighter Mode] in the hand or trash without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Special Rule
text_sections.text: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
